text_snippet: 1.1 “Confidential Information” shall mean any and all data, materials, documents, specifications, designs, drawings, models, samples, reports, analyses, or any other information furnished by Discloser, whether in written, electronic, graphic, oral, or any other form, but only to the extent that such information is labeled or otherwise identified in writing by Discloser as “Confidential” at the time of disclosure. Confidential Information shall not include information which (a) is or becomes publicly known through no wrongful act of Recipient; (b) was rightfully in Recipient’s possession prior to receipt from Discloser; (c) is rightfully obtained by Recipient from a third party having the right to disclose; or (d) is independently developed by Recipient without use of or reference to Discloser’s Confidential Information.
suggested_fix: 1.1 “Confidential Information” shall mean any and all data, materials, documents, specifications, designs, drawings, models, samples, reports, analyses, or any other information furnished by Discloser, whether in written, electronic, graphic, oral, or any other form, but only to the extent that such information is labeled or otherwise identified in writing by Discloser as “Confidential” at the time of disclosure. Confidential Information also includes copies, extracts, notes, summaries, analyses, derivatives, adaptations, and modifications containing or reflecting such information, whether prepared by Recipient, its Representatives, or otherwise. Confidential Information shall not include information which (a) is or becomes publicly known through no breach of this Agreement by Recipient or its Representatives; (b) was rightfully in Recipient’s possession without an obligation of confidentiality prior to receipt from Discloser; (c) is rightfully obtained by Recipient from a third party having the right to disclose it without an obligation of confidentiality; or (d) is independently developed by Recipient without use of or reference to Discloser’s Confidential Information.

text_snippet: 2.1 Recipient agrees to exercise at least the same degree of care to safeguard the confidentiality of Confidential Information as it uses to protect its own similar confidential materials, but in no event less than a reasonable standard of care.
suggested_fix: 2.1 Recipient shall keep Confidential Information confidential and shall exercise at least the same degree of care to safeguard its confidentiality as it uses to protect its own similar confidential materials, but in no event less than a reasonable standard of care. Recipient shall implement reasonable and appropriate physical, technical, and organizational security safeguards, including reasonable procedures to ensure that its Representatives protect Confidential Information in accordance with this Agreement. Except as expressly permitted by Sections 2.2 and 6.1 or with Discloser’s prior written consent, Recipient shall not disclose Confidential Information to any person. Recipient shall promptly notify Discloser upon becoming aware of any loss, unauthorized disclosure or use, misappropriation, or other breach of confidentiality involving Confidential Information.

text_snippet: 2.2 Recipient may use Confidential Information solely for its own internal business purposes, including, without limitation, evaluation, analysis, or discussion concerning a potential business relationship or transaction with Discloser. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to its employees, officers, affiliates, agents, subcontractors, and consultants (collectively, “Representatives”) who have a bona fide need to know such information in connection with the permitted uses set forth above, provided that Recipient has first obtained binding confidentiality obligations from such Representatives that are no less stringent than those set forth in this Agreement.
suggested_fix: 2.2 Recipient may use Confidential Information solely for [COMPLETE: the specific purpose for which the Parties will exchange Confidential Information] (the “Purpose”). Subject to Section 3.3, Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to its employees, officers, affiliates, agents, subcontractors, and consultants (collectively, “Representatives”) who have a bona fide need to know such information for the Purpose, but only to the extent necessary for that Purpose and provided that Recipient has first obtained binding written confidentiality obligations from such Representatives that are no less stringent than those set forth in this Agreement. Recipient shall ensure that its Representatives comply with those obligations. No other internal business use, marketing use, reuse, or commercial exploitation is permitted.

text_snippet: 3.1 Recipient shall not use Confidential Information for any purpose whatsoever other than the specific purpose defined in Section 2.2. Recipient shall not reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble, or otherwise attempt to derive any trade secrets or confidential know‑how embodied in any Confidential Information.
suggested_fix: 3.1 Recipient shall not use Confidential Information for any purpose whatsoever other than the specific purpose defined in Section 2.2. Recipient shall not reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble, or otherwise attempt to derive any trade secrets or confidential know‑how embodied in any Confidential Information. Recipient shall not use Confidential Information in a manner that causes harm or loss to Discloser.

text_snippet: 3.2 Any unauthorized use, disclosure, or duplication of Confidential Information shall constitute a material breach of this Agreement.
suggested_fix:
3.2 Any unauthorized use, disclosure, or duplication of Confidential Information shall constitute a material breach of this Agreement.
   3.3 Discloser shall not provide personal information to Recipient unless Recipient specifically requests it. Each Party shall comply with applicable data protection laws in relation to personal information disclosed under this Agreement, and Discloser shall comply with those laws before providing such information. Recipient shall use personal information only for the Purpose and shall implement appropriate technical and organizational safeguards to protect it. Recipient shall not sell or further disclose personal information, including to Representatives, except to the extent disclosure is legally required under Section 6.1. Personal information shall be subject to the use restrictions, security safeguards, breach notification, and return or destruction requirements of this Agreement whether or not marked or identified as Confidential Information.

text_snippet: 4.1 This Agreement, unless earlier terminated as provided below, shall commence on the Effective Date and shall remain in effect until terminated by either Party providing five (5) days’ prior written notice to the other Party, at which time Recipient’s obligations with respect to Confidential Information received prior to termination shall survive for a period of three (3) years from the date of last disclosure.
suggested_fix: 4.1 This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and, unless earlier terminated by either Party on thirty (30) calendar days’ prior written notice to the other Party, shall remain in effect for three (3) years. Recipient’s confidentiality and use restrictions with respect to Confidential Information received before expiration or termination shall continue throughout the term and shall survive expiration or termination for three (3) years from the date of the last disclosure of Confidential Information under this Agreement, subject to the exclusions in Section 1.1. Expiration or termination shall not affect accrued rights or remedies or relieve Recipient of its return or destruction obligations under Section 5.1.

text_snippet: 5.1 Upon written request of Discloser or upon termination of this Agreement, Recipient may, at its sole discretion, either return to Discloser or destroy all physical and electronic embodiments of Confidential Information. Recipient shall not be obligated to provide any certification or other proof of destruction or return of materials.
suggested_fix: 5.1 Upon written request of Discloser or upon expiration or termination of this Agreement, Recipient shall, at its own expense and as soon as possible, but in any event within ten (10) business days, return to Discloser all Confidential Information or, at Discloser’s written option, securely destroy it. Unless Discloser directs destruction within that period, Recipient shall return the Confidential Information. This obligation includes all physical and electronic embodiments, originals, copies, reproductions, extracts, notes, summaries, analyses, derivatives, and associated metadata in Recipient’s or its Representatives’ possession or control, including backups. Within the same period, Recipient shall provide a certification in physical writing, signed by a senior officer or counsel, confirming complete compliance by Recipient and its Representatives. If applicable law requires retention of any Confidential Information, Recipient may retain only the information and for only the period legally required, shall store it securely, shall not use it for any other purpose, and shall continue to protect it under this Agreement for as long as it is retained. The certification shall identify any such retained information and the legal basis and period for retention. Failure to comply with this Section constitutes a material breach of this Agreement.

text_snippet: 6.1 If Recipient or any of its Representatives is required by applicable law, regulation, or judicial or governmental order to disclose any Confidential Information, Recipient may do so without prior notice to Discloser and without seeking to limit the scope of such disclosure. Recipient shall have no obligation to notify Discloser or cooperate in any efforts to seek a protective order or other limitation on the scope of such compelled disclosure.
suggested_fix: 6.1 If Recipient or any of its Representatives is required by applicable law, regulation, or a valid judicial, administrative, or governmental order to disclose Confidential Information, Recipient may disclose, or permit the relevant Representative to disclose, only the portion legally required. To the extent legally permitted, Recipient shall give Discloser reasonable prior written notice sufficient to allow Discloser an opportunity to seek a protective order or other remedy. Prior notice is not required for a routine regulatory audit or examination, or a blanket document request from a regulatory or governmental authority, that does not reference Discloser or this Agreement. Recipient shall, to the extent legally permitted, consult and cooperate with Discloser on steps to avoid or limit disclosure, take the protective steps agreed with Discloser, and use reasonable endeavors to obtain assurances or an order that the disclosed information will be treated confidentially. Recipient shall ensure that its Representatives comply with these requirements.

text_snippet: 7.1 All Confidential Information, and any derivatives, adaptations, or modifications thereof, shall remain the exclusive property of Discloser. Recipient hereby acknowledges that it obtains no right, title, or interest in or to the Confidential Information except as expressly set forth herein. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Discloser hereby grants Recipient a non‑exclusive, royalty‑free, worldwide license to use the Confidential Information solely for the purposes expressly permitted under this Agreement.
suggested_fix: 7.1 All Confidential Information, and any derivatives, adaptations, or modifications thereof, shall remain the exclusive property of Discloser. Except for the limited permission expressly granted in this Section, no right, title, interest, or license is granted or transferred to Recipient, by sale, assignment, implication, or otherwise, in the Confidential Information or any patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, or other intellectual property rights of Discloser or its licensors. Discloser grants Recipient a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide, revocable, non-transferable license to use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and subject to all restrictions in this Agreement. This license permits access by Representatives only in accordance with Section 2.2, grants no independent rights to Representatives, and does not permit sublicensing. Notwithstanding Section 9.1, the license may not be transferred without Discloser’s prior written consent. The license ends upon its revocation, expiration or termination of this Agreement, or Discloser’s request for return or destruction of the relevant information.

text_snippet: 8.1 Neither Party shall have any liability to the other for any unauthorized disclosure, use, or loss of Confidential Information. Recipient shall not be liable for any breach of confidentiality, and Discloser waives any claims for damages or injunctive relief.
suggested_fix: 8.1 Recipient shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Discloser and Discloser’s personnel against all loss, damage, costs, and expenses, including attorneys’ fees on an attorney and own client basis, arising directly or indirectly from (a) any failure by Recipient or its Representatives to comply with confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations; (b) any breach of this Agreement by Recipient; or (c) any wilful misconduct or fraud by Recipient or its Representatives. This indemnity does not limit Discloser’s other rights or remedies. If Recipient breaches or threatens to breach this Agreement, Discloser may seek injunctive, protective, or other appropriate relief in any court of competent jurisdiction. In a dispute concerning disclosure of Confidential Information, Recipient shall bear the burden of showing that the disclosure was authorized under this Agreement.

text_snippet: 9.1 Recipient may freely assign, transfer, or delegate its rights and obligations under this Agreement, in whole or in part, to any affiliate, successor, or acquirer, without the need for any consent or notice to Discloser. Discloser may assign its rights and obligations hereunder without restriction.
suggested_fix: 9.1 Recipient may assign or transfer its rights and obligations under this Agreement, in whole or in part, to an affiliate, successor, or acquirer only upon prior written notice to Discloser and subject to Section 7.1. Any other assignment or transfer by Recipient requires Discloser’s prior written consent. Recipient may delegate duties to an affiliate, subject to the access and confidentiality requirements of Section 2.2, but any delegation to a non-affiliate requires Discloser’s prior written consent. No delegation relieves Recipient of its obligations under this Agreement. Discloser may assign its rights and obligations hereunder without restriction.

text_snippet: 10.1 All notices, requests, consents, claims, demands, waivers, and other communications hereunder shall be in writing and shall be deemed to have been given (a) when delivered by hand (with written confirmation of receipt); (b) when received by the addressee if sent by a nationally recognized overnight courier (with written confirmation of receipt); or (c) on the date sent by email (with electronic confirmation of transmission). Email shall suffice as notice notwithstanding any failure of the intended recipient to receive such email.
suggested_fix: 10.1 All notices, requests, consents, claims, demands, waivers, and other communications hereunder shall be in writing and sent by hand, nationally recognized overnight courier, or email to the following addresses: Discloser: [COMPLETE: physical street address for notices and service of legal documents; notice email address]; Recipient: [COMPLETE: physical street address for notices and service of legal documents; notice email address]. Each Party designates its stated physical street address as its address for service of legal documents in connection with this Agreement. Either Party may change its designated addresses by giving the other Party at least fourteen (14) calendar days’ prior written notice. Notices shall be deemed given (a) on the date of hand delivery shown by the delivering person’s written record; (b) on the date of delivery shown in the courier’s delivery record; or (c) on the date sent by email with electronic confirmation of transmission. Recipient signature, acknowledgment, or a read receipt is not required for delivery to be effective. Email shall suffice as notice notwithstanding any failure of the intended recipient to receive such email. A communication proven to have actually been received by a Party shall be effective upon receipt even if not sent in accordance with this Section. Any express requirement elsewhere in this Agreement for physical writing or a signed document remains applicable.

text_snippet: 11.1 This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of any jurisdiction selected by Recipient in its sole discretion, without regard to conflict‑of‑law principles.
suggested_fix: 11.1 This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of [COMPLETE: agreed governing jurisdiction], without regard to conflict-of-law principles. Recipient submits to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of [COMPLETE: agreed courts and location] in connection with this Agreement, without limiting Discloser’s right to seek relief in any other court of competent jurisdiction.

text_snippet: 11.2 The Parties agree that any oral agreements, understandings, or representations shall be legally binding, and no written amendment or signature shall be necessary to effectuate any modification to this Agreement.
suggested_fix: 11.2 No amendment or modification of this Agreement shall be effective unless in writing and signed by authorized signatories of both Parties. Oral agreements, understandings, representations, or conduct shall not amend or modify this Agreement.

text_snippet: 12.1 This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the Parties with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous discussions, agreements, and understandings of any kind.
suggested_fix: 12.1 This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the Parties with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous discussions, agreements, and understandings, whether oral or written. Neither Party is obligated to pursue or enter into a future commercial relationship. If the Parties elect not to proceed with the relationship contemplated by the Purpose, Recipient shall return all tangible Confidential Information within the period and with the certification required by Section 5.1, unless Discloser directs destruction under that Section or the Parties enter into a subsequent written agreement expressly providing otherwise. All other Confidential Information remains subject to Section 5.1. Nothing in this Agreement grants exclusivity or restricts Discloser from engaging with other persons or entities.

text_snippet: 12.3 No waiver by either Party of any breach or default hereunder shall be deemed a waiver of any subsequent breach or default.
suggested_fix: 12.3 No waiver shall be effective unless in writing and signed by the Party granting it. No delay, silence, failure to enforce, indulgence, or course of dealing shall constitute a waiver of any right. No waiver by either Party of any breach or default hereunder shall be deemed a waiver of any subsequent breach or default.

12. Miscellaneous
   Costs and publicity. Each Party shall bear its own costs of drafting, negotiating, and executing this Agreement, without limiting Recipient’s obligations under Sections 5.1 and 8.1. Recipient shall not make any formal or informal public announcement or statement concerning this Agreement or the Parties’ contemplated relationship, including through press, blogs, social media, or marketing, without Discloser’s prior written consent.

text_snippet: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
suggested_fix:
12.4 No warranty. Confidential Information is provided “as is” and “with all faults.” To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Discloser makes no representation, guarantee, or warranty, express or implied, concerning its accuracy, completeness, reliability, or suitability, and excludes all implied warranties, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement. Discloser, its employees, consultants, and third-party information providers shall not be liable for errors, omissions, or inaccuracies in Confidential Information. Recipient is responsible for independently verifying its accuracy, completeness, and suitability before relying on it.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.

text_snippet: 12.2 If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid or unenforceable, such provision shall be struck and the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect.
suggested_fix: 12.2 If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid or unenforceable, such provision shall be struck and the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect, provided that severance does not change the core purpose of this Agreement.
